entities.summary: Emilio Bianchi Di Cárcano was an Argentine Roman Catholic priest and prelate. He served as Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Azul from 1982 to 2006, and Bishop emeritus of Azul until his death in August 2021. He was also the titular bishop of Lesina from 24 February 1976, until 14 April 1982.
